_readme: Edit this file to change business details. It is used by the page build AND the Worker. Everything here is public (the repo is public) - never put secrets in it.
tagline: Replacement plastic parts, custom mounts and CAD design in Logan and Brisbane
_siteUrl: Set to your live address with no trailing slash, e.g. https://yourname.com.au. Leave empty until the domain is live: canonical tags, sitemap URLs and structured data are only emitted when this is set.
_contactEmail: Public address shown on the site and used as reply-to on customer emails, e.g. hello@yourname.com.au. Empty = no email shown, the quote form is the only contact route.
_ownerNotifyEmail: Where new-enquiry alerts go (can be your Gmail). Empty = no alert emails.
_emailFrom: Sender for automated emails, on a domain verified with Resend, e.g. PrintAndFit <quotes@printandfit.com.au>. Empty = no emails are sent.
_abn: Shown in the footer once you have one, e.g. 12 345 678 901.
serviceArea: Logan, Daisy Hill, Springwood, Shailer Park, Beenleigh and southside Brisbane
pickupNote: Pickup by arrangement in the Daisy Hill area. Australia-wide postage available.
_gstRegistered: Only set true once you are actually registered for GST. Changes the wording on the terms and how-it-works pages.
_turnstileSiteKey: Cloudflare Turnstile site key (public). Set together with the TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY secret.

materials.label: PLA
materials.note: Rigid, accurate, good for indoor parts. Softens in hot cars and direct summer sun.

materials.label: PETG
materials.note: Tougher and more heat and UV tolerant than PLA. Better for outdoor and light mechanical use.

materials.label: TPU
materials.note: Flexible and rubbery. Feet, bumpers, gaskets and grips.
